WITH norm AS (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    isstoryspotlight,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(language_name, '|') > 0 THEN lower(trim(substr(language_name, 1, instr(language_name, '|') - 1)))

sql = """

WITH norm AS (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    isstoryspotlight,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(language_name, '|') > 0 THEN lower(trim(substr(language_name, 1, instr(language_name, '|') - 1)))
      ELSE lower(trim(language_name))
    END AS lang
  FROM spotlight_cards_with_language
),
spot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid
  FROM norm
  WHERE isstoryspotlight = 1 AND uuid IS NOT NULL
),
french AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.uuid
  FROM norm n
  JOIN spot s ON s.uuid = n.uuid
  WHERE n.lang = 'french'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spot) AS total_spotlight,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM french) AS french_spotlight
)
SELECT
  total_spotlight,
  french_spotlight,
  CASE WHEN total_spotlight = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * CAST(french_spotlight AS DOUBLE) / CAST(total_spotlight AS DOUBLE), 2)
  END AS percentage_french
FROM counts;
"""
